title: Claims Against Public Authorities and Inquest Paralegal
description:
Duncan Lewis Solicitors:

Regulated by the Solicitor's Regulation Authority, Duncan Lewis Solicitors was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in the City of London (Fenchurch Street EC3 M), with offices nationwide. We are recognised by the Legal 500 and Chambers & Partners UK independent legal directories as a top-tier law firm in all of our key practice areas - "a diligent and professional team that is prepared to go the extra mile for its clients". A paperless law firm with over 500 personnel that embraces hybrid-working, we service both corporate entities and private individuals in over 25 areas of law across 60 languages. We give people a voice - that is our ethos.

Recognised among The Times 200 Best Law Firms, we have been awarded Law Firm of the Year at the 2024 Lexis Nexis Awards and 2023 Modern Law Awards, reflecting our dedication to legal expertise and client service. We hold Investors in People Gold Standard accreditation for over 15 years, showcasing our commitment to professional development. Duncan Lewis is also Law Society Lexcel, Cyber Essentials Plus, and ISO 27001 certified, ensuring excellence in practice management and data security.

We are committed to recruiting dedicated and talented professionals and welcome applications from exceptional candidates. At Duncan Lewis, we value training and diversity, and we take pride in our inclusive workforce.

About the role:

Duncan Lewis Solicitors is seeking a talented and experienced paralegals to join its Claims Against Public Authorities and Inquest department

The successful candidate will conduct supervised casework and also support other lawyers in the department. You will be involved with case preparation generally and, as part of that role, will be expected to conduct legal research, take proofs of evidence from clients and witnesses, attend both court hearings and conferences

Experience of Legal Aid Agency (LAA) funded casework is highly desirable. Previous CAPA and/or Inquest experience is advantageous.

It is imperative that you can demonstrate an unwavering commitment to protecting individual citizens' civil liberties and a preparedness to fight hard to enforce their human rights. While experience in CAPA work is advantageous, applications from candidates with relevant legal experience and a genuine interest in civil liberties and human rights work will also be considered.

Main Responsibilities of the Role:
- Reporting to Supervising Solicitor and when necessary to Departmental Director
- Working cohesively within a team but also prepared to take responsibility for individual work.
- Attending clients, taking instructions and briefing and liaising with counsel, negotiating with defendant solicitors, the PPO, IOPC and other legal professionals.
- Drafting legal documents.
- Exercising financial control over work carried out, with particular regard to the conversion of work in progress and ensuring that billing targets are met.
- Ensuring Quality Control compliance as defined in the Office Manual in regard to Lexcel, Investors in People and any other quality mark implemented by the firm, dealing with noncompliance matters in an efficient and timely fashion.
- Supporting the successful development of the firm, in line with its Business Plan, this will require participation in marketing events to ensure the continuous growth of the Department, and that the turnover target set for your department is achieved.
- Dealing with any complaints received on your cases.
- Assisting with audit enquiries, when applicable
- Carrying out any other reasonable and relevant task required by Management

Key Skills Required:
- Minimum 1 year of paralegal practice required; experience in a claims against public authorities department is highly desirable.
- Intelligence and demonstrable experience relevant to this role
- Experience working on Legal Aid cases and Litigation is essential (Ideally within Inquests/CAPA)
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and manage time effectively
- Familiarity with the Legal Aid Agency's online CCMS system would be an advantage
- Legal skills and knowledge, Negotiation skills and Analytical skills
- You must be a good administrator, capable of ordering documents, dealing with new telephone and email enquiries and completing legal aid/controlled work documentation.

What we offer:
- Competitive salary
- The opportunity to join a heavyweight civil liberties firm which promotes a healthy collegiate environment in which to do great work, grow, be supported and be yourself
- Work within a friendly, collaborative and cohesive team
- Excellent progression opportunities
- Support for appropriate legal awards/recognition

The recruitment process will fully comply with GDPR and other applicable laws. Background checks including CRB / DBS checks will establish your eligibility to work in the UK and suitability to the role.

Equal Opportunities:

Duncan Lewis is committed to Equal Opportunities and embraces diversity of its staff. The Company strives to ensure that our staff reflects the diversity of the communities we serve, which is reflective at all levels within our workforce.

We guarantee an interview for candidates that disclose a disability and meet the essential requirements for the post. Please provide additional details in your covering letter if this applies.

APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED BY AGENCIES WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED FOR THE ABOVE VACANCY

title: Data Claims Caseworker Paralegal
description:
Duncan Lewis Solicitors:

Regulated by the Solicitor's Regulation Authority, Duncan Lewis Solicitors was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in the City of London (Fenchurch Street EC3 M), with offices nationwide. We are recognised by the Legal 500 and Chambers & Partners UK independent legal directories as a top-tier law firm in all of our key practice areas - "a diligent and professional team that is prepared to go the extra mile for its clients". A paperless law firm with over 500 personnel that embraces hybrid-working, we service both corporate entities and private individuals in over 25 areas of law across 60 languages. We give people a voice - that is our ethos.

Recognised among The Times 200 Best Law Firms, we have been awarded Law Firm of the Year at the 2024 Lexis Nexis Awards and 2023 Modern Law Awards, reflecting our dedication to legal expertise and client service. We hold Investors in People Gold Standard accreditation for over 15 years, showcasing our commitment to professional development. Duncan Lewis is also Law Society Lexcel, Cyber Essentials Plus, and ISO 27001 certified, ensuring excellence in practice management and data security.

About the Role:

Duncan Lewis Solicitors is seeking a talented and motivated Data Claims Caseworker Paralegal to join its highly regarded Data Claims Department.

The successful candidate will primarily be responsible for the New Client Diary and case set-up/onboarding as well as assistant casework support to the other lawyers in the department. You will be involved with speaking/communicating with new clients and, as part of that role, will be expected to obtain all relevant evidence from them ahead of case opening.

The successful candidate will preferably have prior experience with Data Claims work or at least an interest in data protection, privacy rights as well as unlawful processing/disclosure/retention/misuse of personal data.

Duties and responsibilities
- Reporting directly to the Departmental Director
- Communicating/liaising with new and existing clients by taking initial instructions and obtaining evidence in support of their claims.
- Creating files and preparing all necessary documentation for client onboarding.
- Assisting with casework support from other lawyers in the department.
- Maintaining accurate case records and ensuring compliance with the firm's quality and regulatory standards.
- Managing time recording and file administration effectively.
- Supporting departmental business development and marketing initiatives where required.
- Undertaking any other reasonable duties as directed by Management.

Experience and qualifications
- Minimum one-year of Caseworker Paralegal experience within a law firm/litigation environment.
- Experience with Data Claims work is preferable.
- Interest in dealing with claims involving the UK GDPR 2018, Data Protection Act 2018, privacy rights and misuse of private information is highly desirable.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and manage time effectively.
- Strong analytical and drafting skills.
- Excellent communication and client care skills.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Strong administration and file management skills.
- Experience handling client enquiries, maintaining accurate records and preparing/managing documentation.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to work effectively under pressure.
- Experience using case management systems and Microsoft Office applications.

Benefits

The Company offers competitive salaries and recognises the need to retain and reward its employees through both non-financial lifestyle rewards and financial benefits. The company operates a pay review policy, available to all staff, that sets out clearly salary review procedures available upon meeting performance targets. Our approach to rewards and benefits includes:
- Clear salary review procedures
- Automatic enrolment on to the company's pension scheme.
- 22 days annual leave which increases with length of service
- Additional birthday leave
- 7 days paid occupational sick pay
- Full payment towards annual renewal of Practising Certificate (SRA, CILEX)
- Full payment of Law Society Registration Fee for Panel Membership
- Full payment of Panel membership courses mandatory for Law Society Accreditation
- Individual access to company's e-library resources and training webinar library
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
- Wellbeing support - Mental Health First Aiders available
- Employee Referral/Introduction Scheme
- Eyesight test vouchers
- Maternity gift/vouchers
- Full payment of employment related DBS checks
- Temporary working from abroad (in exceptional circumstances)
- Part-time working considered
- Flexible working arrangements considered, such as Hybrid-Working and Compressed Hours
- Internal training contract intake - apply to train as a solicitor as authorised by the SRA and delivery of training. Successful retention, where appropriate and in accordance with business need, as a newly qualified solicitor
- Support for SQE1 exams
- Clear promotional opportunities (to Supervisor or Director) subject to business needs.
- Company support in becoming more prominent in field of practice through national industry award nominations, national legal directory submissions, media appearances and press releases.
- Enrolment on to Company Medical Cash Plan

subject to terms and conditions.

Company culture

At Duncan Lewis, we are committed to excellence, diversity, and social justice. Our teams work on matters that have a genuine impact on people's lives, often representing vulnerable individuals and holding public bodies to account through expert legal representation.

We foster an inclusive and collaborative working environment where talent is recognised, professional development is encouraged, and employees are supported to achieve their full potential. With award-winning training, clear progression pathways, and a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion, Duncan Lewis offers an exceptional platform for building a successful legal career.

Join a firm where your contribution matters and where you can help give people a voice.

title: TPA Liability Claims Handler

- Experience handling Employers' Liability and/or Public Liability claims.
- A good understanding of liability principles and claims processes.
- Strong negotiation and decision-making skills.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- The ability to manage a varied caseload and work to deadlines.
- A customer-focused approach with strong attention to detail.
- Experience working within delegated authority and agreed claims protocols.

CII qualifications or a willingness to work towards them would be advantageous, but relevant claims experience is the priority.

- Competitive salary based on experience.
- Hybrid working.
- Structured training and professional development.
- Opportunities to progress within a growing claims operation.
- A supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Exposure to a broad and varied portfolio of liability claims.

If you are an experienced Claims Handler looking for your next opportunity within a TPA environment, we'd be keen to hear from you.

title: Receptionist / Administrator
description: We are looking for a Receptionist / Administrator to work 25.5 hours per week - for the right candiate we will also train them to work in our dispensary to cover holidays etc. This role is very varied and interesting. Processing all documents coming into the surgery, both electronically and as paper. Processing repeat prescription requests using the Practice Repeat Prescribing Protocol. Operating the internal messaging systems efficiently and completely. Meeting, greeting and checking-in patients arriving for appointments. Meeting and greeting visitors to the practice and guiding them through the practices signing-in procedure. Updating the patient computer record with administrative details of patients e.g. Change of Address Processing requests for information from Doctors, Practice Nurses and Practice Manager. Making appointments through the computer-based appointments system, using our triage system to establish and record for the clinician a brief reason for the visit / home visit. Dealing with requests and queries raised by patients visiting the practice. Answering the telephone in a timely and appropriate manner. Contacting patients by telephone as required. Various housekeeping duties including assisting with deliveries, collections and keeping the reception area tidy. Other ad hoc tasks required to support the effective and efficient day-to-day running of the practice.

title: Workflow/Admin Assistant
description: We are looking for a skilled Workflow/ Admin Assistant to join our GP surgery team. This role would suit someone who is friendly and empathetic, highly organised and accurate, calm when busy, confident using computers, experienced in customer service or office work and willing to learn and work as part of a team. Working at our practice in Street, Somerset offers the opportunity to be part of a friendly, supportive team serving a welcoming and close-knit community. Street is a vibrant village with a strong community feel, well known for Clarks Village and its beautiful Somerset surroundings, while still within easy reach of Glastonbury, Wells and the Mendip Hills. As a practice, we pride ourselves on teamwork, mutual support and providing high quality care to our patients. We value staff who are approachable, organised and compassionate, and in return we offer a supportive working environment where people are encouraged to learn, develop and feel part of the team. This is a varied and sometimes challenging role. A full description is available but you will be part of a supportive team and each day will be full and rewarding. Liaises with patients, doctors, staff, other support staff, nursing staff, both surgery and attached, community nursing teams, mental health groups, funeral directors, counsellors, pharmacy, social services, commissioning groups, secondary care (acute and community hospitals), care homes, complex care hub and social prescribers Job Purpose, Aims and Profile The Workflow/Admin Assistant post is a multi-skilled position providing a high level of service to patients, internal and external clients and institutions. The post-holder: Works in Workflow responsible for processing and managing all incoming correspondence (electronically and paper) including coding and keeping the patients records accurate and up to date. Works in Data responsible for inputting and updating medical data for an agreed set of patients, and all related administrative tasks. General administrative and clerical duties as requested. Works in Admin responsible for all onward referrals to Secondary Care and other relevant services using systems such as Cinapsis, E-Referrals etc. Organising the timely completion of private medical reports Works in Reception (although the applicant will not specifically work within reception, they would need to have an understanding of how reception works as there may be times that cover and support is needed) working with the Rapid Health triage system; dealing with enquiries; advising on doctors and nurses availability; recording and passing messages on accurately and efficiently; carrying out a range of related reception duties as appropriate. Working Hours and Work Schedule Surgery working week: 08.00 6.30pm Monday to Friday, 08.00 08.00 pm on selected dates. Shared rota with 4 other local practices. Working hours; normal working schedule between 08.30 and 17:00pm or 20.00 pm Monday to Friday as required. Occasional Saturdays throughout the year on a rota basis. Monday; Tuesday; Wednesday; Thursday; Friday: daily schedules to be determined. The post-holder will be required to cover for colleagues who are absent on annual leave or sickness. Duties and Responsibilities Sort all prescription requests, both electronic and manual guided by Pharmacy Team Record any acute prescriptions and pass to the pharmacy team for consideration. Contact patients (when requested) to pass on doctors instructions and requests. Add messages/instructions/date for future action to the medication screen. Sort and place prescriptions ready for collection or according to their destination. Process all information flowing from/to doctors and external institutions as appropriate. Check and process any electronic information as appropriate each day. Process all records from Primary Care Support England as appropriate. Enter appropriate x-ray results read codes and comments from doctors. Sort and distribute all processed, scanned and unscanned documents as appropriate. Add delivery/birth details on mothers and babys screens; including Hospital Unit No. Assist in the processing of Prior Notification Lists from Open Exeter in connection with cervical smears. Ensure correct forms are completed and signed by a GP and returned if a patient needs to be removed from the cervical smear recall list. Check lab links on the screen each day, match any unmatched patients. Undertake SNOMED coding into EMIS. Update, maintain, file and retrieve patient records as appropriate. Scan medical records and file into the EMIS system. Set up systems in preparation for the working day. To assist with the gathering of statistics and information when required. Process deceased patients notes when required. Carry out searches of computerised medical records as requested. Check address template regularly to delete any errors. Process new patient registrations and questionnaires. Process deductions of patient notes when a patient leaves the surgery. Process and manage queries relating to online access requests. Process and manage all incoming correspondence. Managing the diary recall system, to include adding requests onto ICE for blood tests and booking appointments. NHS App and Proxy Access Set up and management Diary Entries Recall Support (including Child Imms, Minor Ops & QOF/Recall) Referrals (ERS & 2WW) - Prepare, process and submit referrals accurately using NHS e-Referral Service (e-RS), Advice and Guidance and other referral pathways such as secure email. Process suspected cancer referrals using C the Signs. Ensure urgent suspected cancer referrals are submitted within required timescales. Cinapsis Referrals and Admin SARS Private Medical Reports Attend for staff training when necessary. Receive, sort and circulate/distribute post. Filing of paper medical records. Attend any other training courses deemed necessary by the Practice Manager or Operations Manager. Carry out any other duties as requested by the Practice Manager or Operations Manager. Other General Conditions Holiday entitlement is five working weeks per year (pro rata) plus any Bank Holidays that fall on a normal working day. All employees are required to adhere to the Health and Safety at Work Act (1974) The job description will be subject to periodic reviews and may be changed in consultation with the post holder. On Appointment the post holder must agree to abide by the Statement of Terms and Conditions of Service and the Contract requirements; all published Surgery protocols; policies; procedures; guidelines and work-rules; and any other approved instruction & documentation that may be amended and issued from time to time.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking for friendly, organised and enthusiastic Receptionists to join our team at Penn Hill Surgery. We have re-organised our reception and secretarial teams to increase our numbers in reception in order to provide the best service to our patients whilst making the role more varied for staff. We are looking for part time receptionists to work regular shifts within our core hours and who would ideally also be able to offer additional hours from time to time to assist with leave cover. Part-time hours available between 08:30 & 18:30, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays & Fridays. Must be available to work on Thursdays & Fridays Full day shifts - all start at 08:30. There are a variety of finish times, 17:30, 18:00 & 18:30, depending on the day Half day shifts - all morning shifts start at 08:30. There are a variety of finish times, eg. 13:00, 13:30, 17:30, 18:00 and 18:30 depending on the day. We are proud of our hardworking, experienced and supportive team, where colleagues work together to provide excellent patient care. Whether you already have experience in general practice or are looking for a new challenge, we will provide full training and support. If you would enjoy a fast-paced role where no two days are the same, can juggle a variety of tasks and enjoy helping people, we would love to hear from you. You'll be joining a supportive team and making a difference to our patients every day. For an informal discussion, please contact Karen Tucker, the Deputy Practice Manager. Provide an efficient, professional and welcoming reception service to patients, visitors and other healthcare professionals. Answer telephone calls, deal with general enquiries, explain practice procedures, signpost patients to the most appropriate clinician or service, and accurately relay messages when required. Book, amend and cancel appointments using practice systems, ensuring patients with urgent clinical needs are managed appropriately using sound judgement and established procedures. Accurately register new and temporary patients, process deductions and maintain patient records using EMIS. Action and complete tasks received through EMIS, AskMyGP and email on a daily basis. Scan and accurately code clinical correspondence onto patients' electronic medical records. Explain practice services and registration requirements to patients and ensure all relevant documentation is completed. Process payments for private (non-NHS) services, issue receipts and maintain accurate financial records. Work closely with clinical and administrative colleagues to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the practice and deliver excellent patient care. Medical records summarising MEDICAL RECEPTIONIST Hours: We welcome applications from candidates who would be available to work within our core hours: On Tues, Weds, Thurs and Fri 08:30-18:30. Hours can be worked over full or half days All morning shifts start at 08:30 There are a variety of finish times available between 13:00, 13:30 (for half days) and 17:30, 18:00 and 18:30 (for full and half days) Place of Work: Penn Hill Surgery Reports to: Deputy Practice Manager Job Summary We are looking for friendly, organised and enthusiastic individuals to join our hardworking and supportive Reception Team. We have increased the hours in the reception team in order to provide greater variety in the day-to-day administrative duties, creating a rewarding role that combines reception responsibilities with a range of administrative tasks. Reception is at the heart of our practice and is often the first point of contact for our patients. This is a busy, fast-paced role where no two days are the same. The successful candidates will enjoy working with people, be able to manage a variety of competing demands, remain calm under pressure and provide a professional, compassionate service to our patients. Whether you have previous experience working in general practice or are looking for a new challenge, we will provide the training and support needed to help you develop in the role. You will work closely with our clinical and administrative teams to ensure patients receive the highest standard of care while contributing to the smooth running of the practice. Main Responsibilities Reception Provide a professional, friendly and efficient reception service to patients, visitors and healthcare professionals. Answer telephone calls, deal with general enquiries and signpost patients to the most appropriate clinician or service. Book, amend and cancel appointments using practice systems. Use your judgement and communication skills to ensure patients requiring urgent medical attention are managed appropriately in accordance with practice procedures. Explain practice services, registration procedures and temporary patient arrangements. Maintain accurate patient records using EMIS. Check and update patient demographic details as required. Process payments for private (non-NHS) services and issue receipts. Administration As well as reception duties, you'll also undertake a variety of administrative tasks, including: Actioning tasks received via EMIS, AskMyGP and email. Processing new patient registrations, temporary registrations and deductions. Scanning and coding clinical correspondence onto patients' electronic records. Supporting the wider practice team with general administrative duties to help ensure the smooth running of the practice. Summarising patient medical records. Premises Prepare the surgery for the start of the working day. Secure the premises at the end of the day when required, ensuring practice procedures are followed. General Responsibilities Attend team meetings, staff meetings and mandatory training. Participate in service improvement initiatives. Maintain confidentiality at all times in accordance with GDPR, NHS guidance and Practice policies. Work flexibly and undertake other duties appropriate to the role as requested by the Partners or Management Team.
